buy.q: How do I buy a course?
buy.a: Open the course, press Buy, and follow the steps on the checkout page. Your access opens as soon as the payment is confirmed.

payment.q: Which payment methods can I use?
payment.a: The ways you can pay are listed on the checkout page for each course. Pick the one that suits you and follow the instructions shown there.

free.q: Are any of the courses free?
free.a: Yes. A course marked Free opens the moment you create an account — no payment and no code.

code.q: How do I use an access code?
code.a: Create an account, open “Redeem code”, and type the code exactly as you received it. The course unlocks straight away.

codeGet.q: How do I get an access code?
codeGet.a: Access codes are handed out by {name}. Get in touch through any of the channels on this site and we'll tell you how.

start.a: Right after your enrolment is confirmed. The course appears in “My learning” and you can open the first lesson immediately.

duration.q: How long do I keep access to a course?
duration.a: Your courses stay in your account, so you can go back to any lesson whenever you need it.

devices.q: Can I watch on my phone?
devices.a: Yes. Everything works in any modern browser on phone, tablet and computer, and your progress follows you between them.

certificate.a: Yes. Finish every lesson — and pass the quizzes, where a course has any — and your certificate becomes available to view and print.

preview.q: Can I see a course before I enrol?
preview.a: Courses that offer free preview lessons are marked in the catalogue. Open one and watch the preview before you decide.

refund.q: What if I change my mind?
refund.a: The refund policy explains when a refund is possible and how to ask for one. It's linked at the bottom of every page.

account.a: Use “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in form and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.

support.a: Reach {name} through any of the contact details on this site and someone will answer you.

default.terms:
By buying a course from {name} you get personal, non-transferable access to it for as long as it is published on this site.

• Your account is yours alone. Sharing your sign-in details, recording lessons, or redistributing course material may end your access without a refund.
• Payment is confirmed manually. Your access opens once {name} has checked the transfer receipt you upload, normally within one working day.
• Course content may be updated, reordered or improved over time.
• {name} is responsible for the content of the courses and for answering questions about them.

If anything here is unclear, contact {name} before you buy.
default.refund:
{name} wants you to be happy with what you bought.

• Ask for a refund within 14 days of your purchase, provided you have watched no more than a small part of the course.
• A course that has been substantially watched or downloaded is not refundable, because the material has already been delivered.
• If a payment was taken twice, or a course you paid for was never opened for you, you get a full refund whenever you report it.
• Refunds go back to the account the payment came from, usually within 14 days of being approved.

To ask for a refund, contact {name} with your order number.
default.privacy:
{name} collects only what running the courses requires: your name, email, phone number, the courses you enrol in, your progress, and the payment receipts you upload.

• Your receipt is stored privately and is seen only by {name} while your order is being checked.
• Your details are never sold, rented, or handed to advertisers.
• Data is kept for as long as your account exists, plus whatever the law requires for financial records.
• You can ask {name} to correct your details, or to delete your account and its data.

For any question about your data, contact {name}.
